en.title: Chocolate Caramel Cream (for Pancake Stack)

steps.n1: Place the sugar in a pan with a little water and cook until it turns slightly golden and becomes caramel.
steps.n2: Add the cream to the caramel, stirring over low heat until completely melted, then add the grated chocolate.
